title: Composed-across-sections text at source-prose pointers: flattened subrace ability scores and merged option-list feature bodies
description:
Residual members of the eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1 item 5 defect class (value emitted at a pointer field-provenance-v1 declares source-prose, but not one verbatim source span), found by the eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1.2 failure-map probe and deliberately left out of that PR because each is a by-design parser composition whose fix changes a representation other code consumes.

MEMBERS (verified on main fb310b8 + PR for eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1.2):
- Flattened subrace ability scores: ancestry:high-elf, ancestry:hill-dwarf, ancestry:lightfoot-halfling, ancestry:rock-gnome. Both /traits/0/text and /abilityScoreIncreases/0/sourceText join the parent race's printed ASI sentence (e.g. 'Your Dexterity score increases by 2.') with the subrace's own (e.g. 'Your Intelligence score increases by 1.'); the two sentences are printed in different sections. parseAncestries deliberately 'merges the additive ability score increase into one trait'; consumers include the ancestry ASI oracle and character creation.
- ancestry:rock-gnome /traits/0/text additionally carries the following 'Artificer's Lore.' trait text (overlaps registry row rock-gnome-boundary, owned by eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2).
- feature:warlock:eldritch-invocations /description: parseFeatures merges the end-of-chapter Eldritch Invocations option list (about 3,000 characters later in the source) into the feature body.

NOT MEMBERS: descriptions that skip roughly 100-400 characters where an embedded table was stripped (spells animate-objects/confusion/creation/reincarnate/scrying/teleport, several magic items and rules). That is verbatim text with a table elided, not composition.

EXPECTED BEHAVIOR: each value is either one verbatim span per source-prose field (e.g. separate verbatim ASI entries/traits for parent and subrace) or is emitted at a pointer truthfully classified source-derived. Decide per member; do not demote whole-kind trait text to source-derived to fix four records.

METHOD: probe values against extractPdfText of the pinned PDF, sentence by sentence (normalize whitespace/hyphen clusters/quotes), recording missing sentences and the source gap between consecutive sentences; extraction interleaving (a table header splitting a sentence) produces false misses and must be confirmed by locating the fragment.

LIKELY FILES: scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseAncestries.ts, parseFeatures.ts, fieldProvenanceDeclarations.ts; tests parseAncestries.test.ts, srdAncestryAbilityScoreIncreases.test.ts, fieldProvenanceGate.test.ts.
